_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::arterial_network#0, and the execution that FALSIFIED its Signal. 4C polices the CFL number itself: on upstream one_d_3_artery_network shortened to 50 steps, TIMESTEP 1e-4 -> 2e-3 aborts in the very first element evaluation with 'CFL number at element 0 is 2.0848661028149182' from art_net/4C_art_net_artery_ele_calc_lin_exp.cpp line 1053, before any time step is written (CFL_STEPS_BEFORE_ABORT=0) and before any result test runs. There is no NaN (CFL_NAN_OCCURRENCES=0) and no 'energy not conserved' message (CLAIMED_ENERGY_TEXT=0). The quantity 4C requires below 1 is sqrt(3)*|lambda|_max*dt/dx, so the real limit is dt < dx/(sqrt(3)*c_max), tighter than the claimed dt <= dx/c_max by sqrt(3).
